notes: This manifest excludes its own hash to avoid a circular digest.
Frozen formal algorithm sources are retained; later documentation and log-index classification changes do not alter recorded performance.
Source/input SHA256 verification and byte-identical offline summary replay are recorded separately in validation.json.
Raw jobs retain original absolute paths. Rebase input paths in new jobs when using an extracted source tree.
Formal timing excludes diagnostic profiling. Signed timestamp residuals and failed profiling attempts are retained.
All nine tiled-versus-hybrid timing failures are preserved. The general hybrid default is unchanged.
No CUDA, RGB, new long soak or fine-search tiling performance claims.
